profile.org_note: Four homebuilding segments (Mid Atlantic, North East, Mid East, South East) plus mortgage banking; segments roll up regions of several metro divisions run by Division Managers, with Market, Regional and Senior Regional Managers above them and Area Presidents over a segment-sized area (titles per NVR's 2016 release; a Jan 2026 posting seeks a Regional Manager for Columbus, Cincinnati and Dayton). No corporate land head is named: each division's General Manager of Land sources lot deals, regional managers carry land-acquisition responsibility, and the full Board approves lot and raw-land contracts above policy thresholds under its lot acquisition policy; finance and treasury sit in Reston under CFO and Treasurer Daniel Malzahn.
profile.summary: NVR builds under Ryan Homes, NVHomes and Heartland Homes in 37 metropolitan areas across 16 eastern and midwestern states plus Washington, D.C., with about 6,300 employees at year-end 2025. It is the original land-light builder: it generally does not develop land and buys finished lots from third-party developers under fixed-price lot purchase agreements with deposits of up to about 10%. At 30 September 2026 it controlled about 185,300 lots, roughly 176,000 of them under lot purchase agreements secured by about $1.03 billion of cash deposits, with only small positions in four joint ventures (about 7,850 lots) and land under development (about 1,450 lots). Headquarters moved in 2026 to 1900 Oracle Way, Suite 300, Reston, VA (previously 11700 Plaza America Drive).
